title: Detects a row edited by someone else mid-run and reports its new values
note: Written with Claude (AI-assisted). Harness task, not a hand-written test.
prompt: Find any order where payment and stock disagree.
checks: Concurrency: the fixture is flagged paid_not_released in the snapshot. While the agent is paused between its snapshot and its re-read, the harness edits the fixture's notes (the only edit a pending_payment WebOrder accepts, so the one another team could really make). The DB must still hold that edit; the agent must report the order as changed during the query, with the new values; because its flag still holds, it must still be in the escalation set.
